roles.heroLead: The builder-grade ensuite your Mill Creek home came with is turning thirty, and its tile was never the waterproof part — the membrane behind tile is, when one exists at all. We build that layer properly, hold a 24-hour flood test, photograph it, and only then set the first tile of the bath you actually wanted.
roles.costH2: How much does tile installation cost in Mill Creek, WA?
roles.costP1: Plan on $14–$26 per installed square foot for Mill Creek tile — the tile, its setting materials, substrate prep and labor all in, labor itself never under $11/sq ft. Surrounds for a tub-shower typically span $3,200–$6,800; the full ensuite package of floor, shower and niche tends to run from $6,500 to $14,000; call a solo bathroom floor (about 45 sq ft) $900–$1,600.
roles.costP2: Format is the lever hiding in every tile quote — not the price of the tile. Setting a $4 mosaic sheet can outrun the cost of a $12 slab-look porcelain plank, since cuts and grout lines are what installers charge for, and a mosaic is made of little else.

roles.layersLead: Behind and beneath visible tile run seven distinct layers. In the Mill Creek failures we're called out to, one was omitted — nine cases in ten it's the membrane — and the few hundred dollars that saved eventually buys a five-figure reopening.
roles.whyP1: An ensuite leak is patient. Water works past the grout and settles into the substrate, surfacing two years down the road as a giving hallway floor or a shadow on the family-room ceiling. What follows is a bill for framing and subfloor, new drywall, and a full re-tile.
roles.whyP2: About 10% of a shower's cost is the waterproofing. Of everything a bathroom remodel can skip, that's the item that costs the most later.

roles.faqH2: Tile installation FAQ — Mill Creek, WA
roles.faqQ1: How much does tile installation cost in Mill Creek, WA?
roles.faqA1: For Mill Creek the all-in number runs from $14 to $26 for each installed square foot — labor, setting materials, substrate prep, tile, everything — and the labor share starts at $11 per square foot alone. Between $3,200 and $6,800 buys the tub-shower surround; floor, shower and niche together, the complete bathroom, commonly settles in the $6,500–$14,000 band. Format outweighs price in the labor column: 12×12 field tile goes down fast, while large-format planks and mosaic sheets both take notably longer per square foot.
roles.faqQ2: How much does it cost to tile a shower in Mill Creek?
roles.faqA2: Standard alcove showers in Mill Creek occupy the $3,200 to $6,800 range — inside that: demolition, the bonded waterproofing system, a pre-sloped base, tile, the niche and grout. Steam, benches, full-height stone or a curbless entry move the total upward. One tenth of the cost, roughly, is waterproofing — the tenth that heads off a repair in the tens of thousands.
roles.faqQ3: Do you waterproof showers before tiling?
roles.faqA3: No exceptions, ever. Rather than plain cement board and thinset, each of our showers gets a bonded waterproofing system: pre-sloped base underneath, membrane drawn up each wall, with corner, seam and penetration all sealed, then a 24-hour flood test — documented, photographed — before tiling begins. Grout slows water; tile slows it more; stopping it entirely is work only the membrane can do.
roles.faqQ4: How long does a bathroom tile job take?
roles.faqA4: The typical Mill Creek bathroom spans four to six working days. Dust control and demo come first; next, substrate and waterproofing, the flood test holding for 24 hours; setting takes a day, sometimes two; grout, silicone and trim wrap it. Before anyone showers, the grout cures for 24 hours more. A floor by itself? One or two days, usually.
roles.faqQ5: Porcelain or ceramic tile — which is better?
roles.faqA5: Underfoot and in the wet, porcelain: denser, harder to chip, water absorption below 0.5%. On walls and backsplashes ceramic serves well for less money. The Mill Creek ensuite recipe we follow keeps porcelain on floors and shower floors while ceramic or glass takes the vertical surfaces.
roles.faqQ6: Can you install a heated tile floor?
roles.faqA6: Yes — no request comes up more in Mill Creek ensuite work. Heated tile via electric radiant mat adds around $11 to $16 per square foot once installed, the thermostat inside that figure, and it's only worth doing during a remodel with the floor already open. Below the mat sits an uncoupling membrane; resistance is confirmed before setting and confirmed again after; power comes from a dedicated circuit.
roles.faqQ7: Do I need to remove the old tile first?
roles.faqA7: Yes in nearly every case. Old-tile removal including haul-away costs about $3.50 per square foot, and it's your single chance to inspect subfloor condition — rot, movement — and hold the new surface flush where it meets doorways. Tile-over-tile can work on a sound, flat, tightly bonded floor, though it raises the height and buries whatever demo would have caught.
roles.faqQ8: How much does a kitchen backsplash cost in Mill Creek?
roles.faqA8: Mill Creek backsplashes around 30 square feet install for $1,100–$2,200 as a rule — that includes cut-outs at outlets, trimmed edges and counter-matched grout. Where the budget climbs is cutting and layout time: mosaic sheets, herringbone, an inset frame detail at the range wall, slab-look porcelain run to the ceiling.
roles.faqQ9: Can you fix cracked tile or regrout instead of replacing?
roles.faqA9: Very often, yes. Priced from $8 per square foot upward, repair-and-regrout work covers darkened or crumbling grout, the odd cracked tile, and shower corners ready for silicone instead of grout. Substrate failure is different: hollow sounds, tiles loosening in sequence, softness behind a wall — there, repairs only postpone. You'll hear which situation is yours before a quote gets written.
roles.faqQ10: Which Mill Creek neighborhoods do you tile?
roles.faqA10: All of Mill Creek — Town Center, the original streets around the country club, East Mill Creek — plus Silver Firs, Seattle Hill, Silver Lake, Martha Lake, Mays Pond, North Creek, Thrashers Corner, Murphys Corner, Eastmont and Cathcart, with regular routes through Bothell, Lynnwood, Everett and the rest of south Snohomish County.
roles.faqQ11: What warranty comes with tile installation?
roles.faqA11: Mill Creek tile work from OC Flooring is backed by a 2-year workmanship warranty — our carpet term is shorter, but tile faults surface in the second year, not the first fortnight. A full manufacturer waterproofing assembly brings the maker's warranty alongside, and the photographed membrane and flood test give you documentation for the life of your ownership.
